commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3d3a38885fb458d7693eab39450dad8506d504f6
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo '=== IAS Zone public send APIs ==='
grep -RniE -B8 -A18 'ias_zone.*(status_change|notification|cmd_req)|status_change.*ias_zone|zone_status_change' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== generic/custom ZCL command APIs ==='
grep -RniE -B10 -A24 '(custom|raw|general|cluster).*cmd.*req|cmd.*req.*(custom|raw|general)|ezb_zcl_.*cluster.*cmd' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee 2>/dev/null | head -800 || true
echo '=== command control / payload types ==='
grep -RniE -B8 -A30 'typedef struct .*cluster_cmd|ezb_zcl_cluster_cmd_ctrl_t|custom.*payload|raw.*payload' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl 2>/dev/null | head -800 || true
echo '=== exported symbols likely usable ==='
find managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib -type f \( -name '*.a' -o -name '*.so' \) -print | while read f; do nm -g "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'ias.*zone.*(status|notif)|zcl.*(custom|raw|cluster).*cmd' || true; done
